topic.title: Turtle Library Overview
topic.description: Explores Turtle module attributes: printing the turtle object reference and reading screen canvas dimensions. Builds familiarity with the turtle environment.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Accessing screen properties like canvwidth, and understanding that turtle methods return objects with their own attributes.
learningNotes.challenges: Understanding the difference between the Turtle object and the Screen object.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Explore pen properties: pencolor, fillcolor, pensize.

files.description: Prints turtle object info and screen canvas width.
